description.zh: 用于跨账号备份的原账号RAM中创建的角色名。
description.en: The name of the RAM role that is created in the source account for cross-account backup.

description.zh:
跨账号备份类型。支持： 
- SELF_ACCOUNT：本账号备份 
- CROSS_ACCOUNT：跨账号备份
description.en:
The type of cross-account backup. Valid values:

- SELF\_ACCOUNT: Backs up data within the current account.

- CROSS\_ACCOUNT: Backs up data across accounts.

description.zh: 用于跨账号备份功能中的原账号ID。
description.en: The ID of the source account that is used for cross-account backup.
The IDs of the ECS instances. You can specify a maximum of 20 instance IDs.

descriptions.zh:
- 该接口将创建一个后台的异步任务，调用云助手在ECS实例中安装备份客户端。
- 任务结果可以通过[DescribeTask](~~431265~~)获得。
- 任务超时时间为15分钟。建议任务创建60秒后，再首次查询，每30秒查询一次结果。
descriptions.en:
- This operation creates a background asynchronous task. The task uses Cloud Assistant to install backup clients on ECS instances.

- Call the [DescribeTask](~~431265~~) operation to get the task result.

- The task timeout is 15 minutes. After the task is created, wait 60 seconds before making the first query. Then, query the result every 30 seconds.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun hbr install-backup-clients --instance-ids '[i-0xi5wj500000v3j3bh2gj5]' --cross-account-type CROSS_ACCOUNT --cross-account-user-id 16392782 --cross-account-role-name BackupRole --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun hbr InstallBackupClients --region cn-hangzhou --CrossAccountUserId 16392782 --CrossAccountRoleName BackupRole --CrossAccountType CROSS_ACCOUNT --InstanceIds '["i-0xi5wj500000v3j3bh2gj5"]'
